Sandbox_RQ_Enabled_tooltip: Master toggle for all special zombie spawning.
Sandbox_RQ_DebugMode_tooltip: 100%% conversion rate for testing. Do not use in normal play.
Sandbox_RQ_ConvertAccess_tooltip: Who may use the zombie conversion and inspection tools. Admin only: requires the highest access level. All staff: any role holding at least one capability. Default is Admin only - conversion is a lot of power.
Sandbox_RQ_SpawnChance_tooltip: Chance for a zombie to become special, in whole percent (0-100). 0 = no specials at all, 100 = every zombie. Default 10. NOTE: this was a dropdown in 1.1.0 - if you are upgrading, set this value again, because the old saved setting is a menu position (1-7) and will read as 1-7%% now.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerWeight_tooltip: Chance this type is picked when a special zombie spawns, in whole percent (0-100). Weights don't need to total 100%% - remainder means no spawn. 0 takes the type out of the lottery. Default 5. Re-set this after upgrading from 1.1.0: the old saved value was a menu position, not a percent.
Sandbox_RQ_JuggernautWeight_tooltip: Chance this type is picked when a special zombie spawns, in whole percent (0-100). 0 takes the type out of the lottery. Default 15. Re-set this after upgrading from 1.1.0: the old saved value was a menu position, not a percent.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPWeight_tooltip: Chance this type is picked when a special zombie spawns, in whole percent (0-100). 0 takes the type out of the lottery. Default 20. Re-set this after upgrading from 1.1.0: the old saved value was a menu position, not a percent.
Sandbox_RQ_GluttonWeight_tooltip: Chance this type is picked when a special zombie spawns, in whole percent (0-100). 0 takes the type out of the lottery. Default 30. Re-set this after upgrading from 1.1.0: the old saved value was a menu position, not a percent.
Sandbox_RQ_ScavengerWeight_tooltip: Chance this type is picked when a special zombie spawns, in whole percent (0-100). 0 takes the type out of the lottery. Default 5. Re-set this after upgrading from 1.1.0: the old saved value was a menu position, not a percent.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerEnabled_tooltip: Screamer (Red): repeating scream attracts and spawns zombies.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerCastTime_tooltip: How long the screamer charges before screaming. Also used by Boss Scream skill cast.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerTriggerRange_tooltip: Player must be within this range to trigger a scream. Also gates the range of the raging Scavenger disorientation effect.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerSoundRadius_tooltip: How far the scream attracts zombies. Also used by Boss Scream skill and the one-shot scream that fires when a Scavenger rages.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerSpawnMin_tooltip: Minimum zombies spawned when few are nearby.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerSpawnMax_tooltip: Maximum zombies spawned when few are nearby.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerSpawnThreshold_toolti: Screamer only spawns new zombies if fewer than this many are nearby.
Sandbox_RQ_JuggernautEnabled_tooltip: Juggernaut (Blue): high HP tank with passive aura that buffs nearby zombies.
Sandbox_RQ_JuggernautHealthMultiplier_to: HP multiplier applied when a zombie becomes a Juggernaut. Uses at least vanilla-normal zombie health as the base so fragile zombies do not become paper-thin Juggernauts.
Sandbox_RQ_JuggernautBuffRadius_tooltip: Range of the buff aura. Shared by Juggernaut passive buff, Boss buff aura, and raging Scavenger aura.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPEnabled_tooltip: EMP (Yellow): detonates on death, drains electronics and exhausts players.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPTriggerRange_tooltip: Not currently used (EMP triggers on death). Reserved for future use.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPCastTime_tooltip: Seconds after EMP zombie dies before detonation. Escape window for players. Also used by Boss EMPulse skill cast.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPRadius_tooltip: Range of the EMP detonation on electronics, players, and zombies. Also used by Boss EMPulse skill.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPBatteryDrain_tooltip: Percentage of charge drained from electronics (generators, world powered devices, player inventory batteries/flashlights). Also used by Boss EMPulse skill.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPBlindMinMs_tooltip: Shortest blackout when caught in the INNER half of an EMP blast, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). Each blast rolls a duration between Min and Max. Clamped down to Max if set higher. Default 500.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPBlindMaxMs_tooltip: Longest blackout when caught in the INNER half of an EMP blast, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). 0 = blinding disabled entirely. Only the inner half of the blast radius blinds; the outer ring deafens only. Default 2000.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPDeafMinMs_tooltip: Shortest deafness after being caught anywhere in an EMP blast, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). Each blast rolls a duration between Min and Max. Clamped down to Max if set higher. Default 3000.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPDeafMaxMs_tooltip: Longest deafness after being caught anywhere in an EMP blast, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). 0 = deafening disabled entirely. Uses the engine's real Deaf-trait audio mix; repeat blasts extend the timer rather than stacking. Default 5000.
Sandbox_RQ_GluttonEnabled_tooltip: Glutton (Green): eats corpses to grow stronger over time.
Sandbox_RQ_GluttonRadius_tooltip: How far Gluttons and Scavengers search for corpses to eat.
Sandbox_RQ_GluttonMaxMult_tooltip: Maximum HP multiplier the Glutton can reach by eating.
Sandbox_RQ_DevourTime_tooltip: How long Gluttons and Scavengers take to consume a corpse.
Sandbox_RQ_ScavengerEnabled_tooltip: Scavenger (Green): eats corpses like a Glutton. Rages into a Juggernaut when damaged.
Sandbox_RQ_BossCastTime_tooltip: How long Boss skills take to cast. Boss is admin-spawn only.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowHealthBars_tooltip: Display health bars above all zombies. Intended for admin/testing use.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerSpacing_tooltip: Minimum tiles (0-150) between two Screamers. Gluttons/EMPs/etc don't count - this only checks against other Screamers. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_RQ_JuggernautSpacing_tooltip: Minimum tiles (0-150) between two Juggernauts. Different types don't block each other. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_RQ_EMPSpacing_tooltip: Minimum tiles (0-150) between two EMP zombies. Different types don't block each other. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_RQ_GluttonSpacing_tooltip: Minimum tiles (0-150) between two Gluttons. Different types don't block each other. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_RQ_ScavengerSpacing_tooltip: Minimum tiles (0-150) between two Scavengers. Different types don't block each other. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowBossRing_tooltip: Show ground ring under Boss zombies (passive buff aura + skill cast telegraphs like Scream and EMPulse). Default on - Boss is apex tier and the ring is the only readable telegraph of incoming skills.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowEMPRing_tooltip: Ground rings shown while a dying EMP counts down to detonation: outer teal ring = full blast radius, inner orange ring = knockdown zone. This is the only ground warning of a pending blast, so it defaults ON. Turn off for maximum surprise.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowGluttonRing_tooltip: Show ground ring under Gluttons during the eating cast. Default off.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowJuggernautRing_tooltip: Show ground ring under Juggernauts marking the radius of their HP buff aura. Default off.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowScavengerRing_tooltip: Show ground ring under Scavengers - eating cast while passive, rage-color aura while enraged. Default off.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowScreamerRing_tooltip: Show ground ring under Screamers during their scream cast. Default off.
Sandbox_RQ_ShowCastBarText_tooltip: Show text labels above cast bars (e.g. 'Devouring...', 'Buffing...', 'Screaming...'). EMP labels always show regardless since they're critical danger telegraph. Default off for clean visuals.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerBlurStrength_tooltip: How strong the blur lens is when a Screamer howls (0=none, 100=full). Scales the blur for all trait variants (brave, normal, cowardly). Also applies to Boss Scream and raging Scavenger disorientation. Default 100.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerDarkStrength_tooltip: How dark the screen gets when a Screamer howls (0=none, 100=full). Independent of blur - set to 0 for blur-only effect. Also applies to Boss Scream and raging Scavenger disorientation. Default 100.
Sandbox_RQ_ScreamerVolume_tooltip: How loud the scream itself plays (0=silent, 100=full). Also covers the Boss Scream skill and the one-shot scream a raging Scavenger fires. Audio only: at 0 the scream still attracts zombies, still blurs and darkens the screen, and still shows its cast bar - it just makes no noise. Distance fade applies on top, so a distant scream is quieter than this setting. Default 100.
